scope: Conditional omission diagnostics at the pinned current-source eight-cell supplied state; no atmosphere or observer adequacy claim.

fixed: T, electron density, H/He charge reservoirs, mass, geometry and baseline external continuum in every cell.
solved: 62 excited-to-ground ratios per cell and local finite-column He line destruction/recapture.
model.coefficients: Fresh supplied-state C23 CI/LTE/collider/DR data; full-Milne capture and kinetic cooling from separately qualified resolved43 and collapsed20 bare cross sections. No topoff or escape-weighted capture.
model.line_closure: Native continuous-core finite-cell operators, same cap splits and photon source, order16 then32; gathered-ray adapter independently matches the original native integral.
model.extinction: Baseline true absorption minus old ground-He absorption plus new He absorption minus induced emission; no clipping.
model.photons: Positive destruction events are partitioned into He absorption, induced emission and other-species absorption using the same net extinction. Escaped line and two-photon radiation are separate forcing outputs.
model.two_photon: Both spontaneous channels included; induced two-photon off. Their spectra are not yet returned to local photoionization.
model.thermal: Paired CI/three-body binding ledger, photoelectric/induced/Milne kinetic ledger, and collisional line exchange; spontaneous line emission is not counted twice as local heat.
model.charge: Existing native ground H/He CT is included in reported fluxes, not in the constrained excited-row matrix.

interpretation: Excited He continuum and kinetic heat are small at this supplied state, but the relative helium charge response is not bounded small.

Large gross CI/three-body cycles nearly cancel. Positive absorbing-chain elimination reproduces the same net charge forcing and shows reduced successful capture and enhanced ionization in upper cells.

Changing only the old ground photo cross section gives a much smaller charge forcing than the full conditional change. Remaining changes include both atomic coefficients and excited-state processing, not pure excitation.
The ground atomic cross-section replacement can change local continuum opacity materially; its global attenuation response has not been recomputed.

The charge forcing divided by electron inventory has units s^-1; it is not a fractional atmospheric change or a solved electron correction. The supplied HeII is a trace contribution to the electron inventory.
helium.convention: C23 source LTE mass convention is retained for CI/three-body pairing; its factor relative to the free-electron prefactor is 0.99979445. It is not called an independently derived physical reduced-mass correction, and qualified Milne coefficients are not rescaled.

titanium.model: Passive TiI/II/III charge ladder and four separately normalized legacy TiII pairs at fixed T/ne/H and radiation, in every cell; not a lower-LTE-boundary replacement.
titanium.interpretation: Collisional line exchange can heat the lower cells and cool higher cells. The destroyed-photon energy is a forcing for other absorbers, not extra local kinetic cooling. Four pair populations must not be summed for mass or charge.

limits: Supplied non-root state with F infinity0.232; no final-root omission bound or atmospheric adequacy claim.
The external continuum is fixed: its changed He attenuation, free-bound emission and two-photon emission do not feed back globally.
Two spontaneous channels are included in populations and energy forcing; induced two-photon transitions remain off, and their spectra are not returned to local excited-He photoionization.
Ground H/He CT is included in the reported charge fluxes using the existing native rates; it is absent from the constrained excited-row matrix.
DR inverse is unimplemented and its source-defined maximal positive charge flux is reported. No unsupported DR kinetic cooling term is invented.
Atomic size, full thermal/flow response, all temperature-domain conditions and NUTS remain unqualified.
All eight charge/electron reservoirs are held fixed, including the prescribed lower boundary cells. No charge neutrality or mass update is implied.
Absorbing-chain successful fluxes freeze the converged conditional radiation coefficients. They are not a new charge equilibrium or a nonlinear derivative.
Earlier continuum-review wording marked collapsed input pending; the separately pinned collapsed review supplied and qualified it before the solve.
Ti photo quadrature at newly introduced thresholds is unqualified; the reported top-stage photo loss does not bound all TiIII-to-IV channels.
Ti excitation derivatives vary only the pair log ratios at fixed reservoirs; no parameter, atmosphere or implicit-root derivative is claimed.
Local heat, charge and opacity contributions are not complete atmospheric or spectral response bounds.
All six full-use Assessments remain unknown. Repeat at the accepted root and check a nonlinear response before adopting an omission bound.
preserved_failures: Original He quadrature controls failed refinement or source-operator parity before the separate corrected qualifications; original receipts are retained locally.

The original Ti mass diagnostic omitted atomic-mass grams. A separate correction preserves its source/output and verifies all other33 arrays and line inputs bitwise unchanged; it never entered the solved equations.
publication: Aggregate scalars, model definitions and hashes only. New raw atomic/reference/atmosphere arrays and replay archives remain local.
